limitations: Only regular decrypted local files; no USB, raw eMMC or live device paths.
WBI input is exactly the extracted 248376320-byte logical content, not a full partition dump.
CP input is the extracted 25008128-byte nflasha8 partition image, not a live dump.
Normalized full-file hashes deliberately reject unrelated runtime/settings changes.
Known snapshot counter constants are not a general runtime rule evaluator.
Generated plans contain logical file offsets and are not device write plans.
Historical feature tests do not establish a new combined USB installation/closure test.
